name: pwa-kit
description: What every installed web app shows about itself, for React PWAs, and the test settings that go with it: @pwa-kit/whats-new (the Update ready summary, a one-time What's new sheet after an update, the versions list for About, a Check for updates button and the version link to CHANGELOG.md on GitHub, a React package), @pwa-kit/tips (a list of one-time tips, which one to show now, dismissed for good through an injected storage), @pwa-kit/test-preset (vitest and Playwright timeouts sized for a loaded host, the MW_TIMING filter, settleAfterTeardown), @pwa-kit/alive (useAlive(), a guard for a setState after an await) @pwa-kit/tap (a shared tap guard so the second tap of a double tap is swallowed, and a two-tap helper for jsdom and Playwright) @pwa-kit/launch-gate (a launch gate that opens the app's store with a timeout, says what it waits on after 3 s, offers Try again after 10 s and says it failed at 15 s, a React package) @pwa-kit/app-update (the PWA update state machine: look for a new build, offer a waiting one, apply it and reload once, or anyway after 10 s, with an optional quiet take-over of a build with nothing new, judged now or later and reloading the page, a React package) @pwa-kit/picture-viewer (a picture full screen on the browser's top layer, above any z-index an app uses: pinch, drag, double tap, Close, Escape and Back, and an optional Save, a React package) @pwa-kit/settings (settings declared once with defineSetting, a registry over injected storage that checks and applies a change, one searched list of rows that hides a setting whose dependency is unmet and a group with nothing to show, and a SettingsHome of groups and a search box, a React package) and @pwa-kit/requests (a request to the maker filed by the tutor from a talk, never a form: the words and who asked, one a day for the same words, a budget per day, the expected asks listed for the settings, and the status of each seen through a reader the app injects, a React package) and @pwa-kit/day (the user's own calendar day as a YYYY-MM-DD key, never the UTC day, and an ESLint rule, no-utc-day, against the UTC day).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/whats-new/tsconfig.build.json packages/tips/tsconfig.build.json packages/test-preset/tsconfig.build.json packages/alive/tsconfig.build.json packages/tap/tsconfig.build.json packages/day/tsconfig.build.json packages/launch-gate/tsconfig.build.json packages/app-update/tsconfig.build.json packages/picture-viewer/tsconfig.build.json packages/settings/tsconfig.build.json packages/requests/tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.copyFileSync('packages/whats-new/src/styles.css', 'packages/whats-new/dist/styles.css'); fs.copyFileSync('packages/settings/src/styles.css', 'packages/settings/dist/styles.css')"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/whats-new/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/alive/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/tap/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/launch-gate/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/app-update/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/picture-viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/settings/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/requests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
